notes: Trigger-only evals. This skill drives a live Facebook session, so output cannot be benchmarked deterministically; these cases just exercise description triggering (should-trigger vs should-not-trigger).

expectations: Sweeps the FB Marketplace inbox and summarises pickups by day

evals.prompt: check the messages people sent me about my listings, I want to see pickup dates we've agreed to
expectations: Reports agreed pickup dates/times in Melbourne time

evals.prompt: what pickups have I agreed to this week?
can you add my marketplace pickups to my calendar?

list my coffee table on facebook marketplace
